scope: X-M1 1.50 USB mode-two PTP application source checkpoint, not a complete application engine

source_evidence.claim: The command dispatcher selects the 0x10, 0x90 and 0x98 tables with respective inclusive low-byte limits 0x1c, 0x1d and 0x0b. Open-session validates the zero suffix before zero-session and already-open checks. Close-session checks session presence before the zero suffix.
The local descriptor table at 0x00d935d4 contains four descriptors. These are protocol-local properties, not evidence of identity with settings property identifiers 1 through 645.
The application has storage, object, capture and extended object-property branches. An operation identity is not an implemented handler.

handler_tables.recovery: Little-endian 32-bit entries read from the owner-supplied BIN5 image, load address 0x00bf1a00. The tables have 29, 30 and 12 entries respectively.
handler_tables.unsupported_entries: Other standard slots use operation-specific unsupported handlers; remaining vendor and extended slots select 0x00d8cd5c. The Rust decoder returns None for these operation codes.

implemented_scope: Closed operation decoder for every non-unsupported command-table slot
Session identifier transitions and source-ordered protocol response codes
Allocation-free four-property current-value and descriptor snapshot encoders
Typed initiator dataset length admission and battery states
Behavioral tests for session ordering, response transaction identity, property wire values, short-output atomicity and operation admission

missing_actual_cpu.surface: Concrete PtpApplication dispatch and transport integration
missing_actual_cpu.detail: No PtpApplication root is supplied by this checkpoint. Object enumeration, object information, whole/partial reads, thumbnail reads, upload, delete, extended properties and vendor operations are not implemented here. Operation decoding does not claim those branches are complete.

0x00d86b10 invokes application backend slot +0x2c and expects completion argument 10. The known capture configuration facade is not proof of this provider's identity. A source-bound canonical initiation/completion/cancellation provider remains required.

0x00d939b0 and 0x00d94554 depend on actual JPEG, RAF, movie and thumbnail parsing. The shared media_parser provider is assigned separately. Calibration metadata.rs is not a replacement for these codecs.

0x00d93070 copies the current initiator value and can recognize Windows/<version> greater than 5, update operation and format tables, invoke 0x00d91ec8, emit event 0x4008 and call 0x00d94714(2). A value-only setter would omit valid CPU and is deliberately absent.

PtpRuntime owns the session identifier; open_session and close_session apply the session rules to it. The concrete application must also clear transfer scratch on open and execute the 0x00d8645c cleanup dependency on successful close.

canonical_provider_contracts.file: filesystem_file_cpu::FileCpu, FileHandle, OpenMode, SeekFrom and typed errors
canonical_provider_contracts.catalog: filesystem_catalog::Catalog, Entry, MediaPath, CreateKind, create/delete/io and allocation_bitmap
canonical_provider_contracts.metadata: media_parser::metadata and parse, MediaFormat, MediaMetadata and ThumbRange; no zero-dimension fallback
canonical_provider_contracts.property: Protocol-local descriptor identities have no proven direct mapping to property_service::PropertyId
canonical_provider_contracts.wireless: Wireless 0x013f command handlers remain distinct. Shared filesystem providers do not establish USB/network application identity.

verification.qualification: source inspection only; no completed application, parity, retirement or hardware claim
